Results.Name: Chronological printed readings and explicit ranges remain documentary and input files are unchanged
Different scanners, head/body modes, systems, slices and metrics are separate series
Slice-thickness millimetres use their own metric descriptor and cannot mix with HU values
Historical reference caches never become current points or pending measurement work
A reference cache alias cannot override or fabricate conflicts with verified current evidence
Printed failures and values outside printed limits stay visible with review warnings
Missing or invalid printed bounds do not invent limits or discard the current numeric value
Uncertain dates and incomplete reads never enter the chart as normal points
Verified footer dates can supply missing indexed dates and period boundaries are inclusive
Only the newest revision of a source is charted and an ambiguous revision timestamp is withheld
Content aliases and identical timestamp values are deduplicated without averaging conflicts
Disagreeing reader caches for identical PDF aliases cannot select an arbitrary reading
Pending coverage includes old measurement caches and unknown dates without retrying failed reads
Changed saved-file metadata invalidates trend evidence and requires a new verified read
Queries reject unsupported inputs and public results exclude private record fields
Unknown completeness flags cannot become verified chart evidence
Pending read identities are capped while the complete pending count stays visible
Plot point limits preserve full-period summary statistics and disclose truncation
Monthly scalar alignment has fixed millimetre metrics and no fabricated system or slice
Printed sagittal and coronal axes remain separate series and alias conflicts stay within their own axis
Alignment requires its exact fixed context and recognized current document rather than legacy numeric labels
Only eligible older alignment caches wait for one capability upgrade and attempted unsupported layouts stop retrying
Table-position methods and numbered positions remain eight separate source-linked millimetre series
Incomplete or untrusted cached table blocks cannot publish partial method series
Only older complete table evidence waits for a capability-four read while existing measurements remain usable
Selected-metric coverage distinguishes absent tests from unusable evidence without counting pending or references twice
The production query reads managed archive state without rebuilding dashboard attention

Scope: Synthetic owned PDF bytes and independently verified analysis-cache provenance. Current-source revisions, separate measurement contexts, printed outliers/review flags, date conflicts, alias deduplication, pending/error coverage, strict query values and public-data privacy are exercised. No scanner network, real clinical report or clinical pass/fail inference is used.
